procedure: For each complete source sample, copy once into a dedicated external input directory preserving its repository-relative path; use that same source directory for both binaries. Three fresh-output CLI extractions per binary, alternating old/new order by repeat. No cached output reuse. Same --code-only --no-viz --store sqlite options. Timeout and stream failures stay visible; no latency ratio if either observation is unavailable. Retain commands, wall time, outputs and graph digests. Full graph JSON and published canonical graph digests are compared; any nondeterministic metadata exclusion must be reported.
limitations: Unoptimized development binaries with matching explicit build settings; not release-performance qualification.
Three observations per binary and file, alternating order with fresh outputs and ordinary OS caches; no warmups or OS-cache flushing.
The same host also runs unrelated work; recorded load averages do not prove isolation. No confidence interval or tool-wide speed ranking.
Samples were selected before the candidate results but after profiling the CloudStack timeout. This is diagnosis, not held-out confirmation.
Graph equality includes all JSON fields and preserves array order. A missing baseline graph cannot establish old/new equality.
This optimization does not implement or validate god-object classification. Original full-repository timeout/admission failures remain unchanged.
